name: vsconsult
description: A keyboard-first, Consult-like picker for VSCodium.

vsconsult.previewDebounceDelayMs.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds between a selection change and showing the preview. Lower values make previews feel snappier but trigger more reads; higher values reduce read churn while moving quickly through candidates. Set to `0` to preview immediately. Changes apply live.

vsconsult.previewFullMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum file size in bytes that receives a complete textual preview (default `1048576` = 1 MiB). Files larger than this are shown as a truncated excerpt sized by `#vsconsult.previewExcerptMaxBytes#`.

vsconsult.previewExcerptMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Number of bytes shown from the start of a file that exceeds `#vsconsult.previewFullMaxBytes#` (default `524288` = 512 KiB). A visible truncation notice is appended so the excerpt is never mistaken for the whole file.

vsconsult.fileExcludes.markdownDescription: Glob patterns always excluded when sourcing workspace files, in addition to `.gitignore` and `.gitmodules` contents. Patterns are merged into a single `{...}` exclude set. Replaces the built-in baseline list, so include the defaults here if you want to keep them.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
